text: The subject is Kiran Rehman, who holds account PK**ABPA****5563 opened on 31 January 2022. The subject declared an occupation of Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month. Between 3 August 2026 and 9 August 2026, the account recorded 15 credits totalling PKR 830,000 and 3 debits totalling PKR 784,000. The credits consisted of 15 interbank (IBFT) transfers received from 14 distinct senders. An alert was raised by Tazama on 9 August 2026, where Tazama typology MULE-01 scored 360 against an alert threshold of 300. The receipt of funds from 14 distinct senders is indicative of money mule activity. Debits equal to 94% of credits, with a median of 3.4 hours between the latest credit and each debit, are consistent with suspected money mule activity. Credits in the activity window were 27.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile and indicative of money mule activity. The pattern of 14 distinct senders and credits 27.7 times the declared monthly income of PKR 30,000 per month for a Student is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 472,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 312,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 29 August 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review by L2 analyst on 12 August 2026.
